package main

import (
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

// channelsValidName: starts with '#', 2 to 32 chars, no spaces, commas or control characters.
func channelsValidName(n string) bool {
	if len(n) < 2 || len(n) > 32 || n[0] != '#' {
		return false
	}
	for i := 0; i < len(n); i++ {
		ch := n[i]
		if ch <= 0x20 || ch == 0x7f || ch == ',' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// channelsSendNames sends the 353 and 366 lines for a channel name to c.
func channelsSendNames(s *Server, c *Client, name string) {
	display := name
	if ch := s.channels[strings.ToLower(name)]; ch != nil {
		display = ch.name
		nicks := make([]string, 0, len(ch.members))
		for _, m := range ch.members {
			nicks = append(nicks, m.Nick)
		}
		sort.Strings(nicks)
		c.Send(":" + serverName + " 353 " + c.Nick + " = " + display + " :" + strings.Join(nicks, " "))
	}
	c.Send(":" + serverName + " 366 " + c.Nick + " " + display + " :End of /NAMES list")
}

func channelsJoin(s *Server, c *Client, m Message) {
	if len(m.Params) < 1 {
		s.Reply(c, "461", "Not enough parameters")
		return
	}
	name := m.Params[0]
	if !channelsValidName(name) {
		c.Send(":" + serverName + " 403 " + c.Nick + " " + name + " :No such channel")
		return
	}
	key := strings.ToLower(name)
	if c.channels[key] {
		return
	}
	ch := s.channels[key]
	if ch == nil {
		ch = &channel{name: name, members: map[string]*Client{}}
		s.channels[key] = ch
	}
	ch.members[strings.ToLower(c.Nick)] = c
	c.channels[key] = true
	line := ":" + c.Prefix() + " JOIN " + ch.name
	for _, mem := range ch.members {
		mem.Send(line)
	}
	channelsSendNames(s, c, ch.name)
}

func channelsPart(s *Server, c *Client, m Message) {
	if len(m.Params) < 1 {
		s.Reply(c, "461", "Not enough parameters")
		return
	}
	name := m.Params[0]
	key := strings.ToLower(name)
	ch := s.channels[key]
	if ch == nil || !c.channels[key] {
		c.Send(":" + serverName + " 442 " + c.Nick + " " + name + " :You're not on that channel")
		return
	}
	line := ":" + c.Prefix() + " PART " + ch.name
	if len(m.Params) > 1 {
		line += " :" + m.Params[1]
	}
	for _, mem := range ch.members {
		mem.Send(line)
	}
	for k, mem := range ch.members {
		if mem == c {
			delete(ch.members, k)
		}
	}
	delete(c.channels, key)
	if len(ch.members) == 0 {
		delete(s.channels, key)
	}
}

func channelsNames(s *Server, c *Client, m Message) {
	if len(m.Params) < 1 {
		s.Reply(c, "461", "Not enough parameters")
		return
	}
	channelsSendNames(s, c, m.Params[0])
}

func channelsInitBody() {
	handlers["JOIN"] = channelsJoin
	handlers["PART"] = channelsPart
	handlers["NAMES"] = channelsNames
}
